title: Woodburn Dragstrip

services.name: Ticket
services.desc: For our new fans and spectators: We do not have an end time listed for our races. The duration of the races depends on the car count for the day and if any delays happen during the event. OFFICE HOURS: We are open Wednesday through Sunday, 9 am - 4:30 pm. There are days when we will not be open, so please always call before you come out to the track. Woodburn Dragstrip observes Holidays and will be closed on the following days: New Year’s Eve and New Year’s Day, Easter Sunday, Mother’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day & the Friday After, Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. September 12th - Saturday ~ Last Specialty Racing Series race for Modern Muscle #8, Pickup
